description: Source file implementing the ClientRepository class for OAuth2 client management in the SuiteCRM project. It interacts with OAuth2Clients data and implements methods to retrieve client entities and validate clients based on identifiers, secrets, and grant types.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 ClientRepositoryInterface to retrieve and validate OAuth2 clients from the database

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a client entity object for the given client identifier, returns null if not found.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates the client credentials and grant type, returns true if valid, false otherwise.
